answer: Dawn census stops bulk fake identities. Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files one key-signed return at dawn, naming voyage route, nectar harvest. Auditors re-check 1 in 8 against the voyage and nectar tables; a missing or copied return burns the bond. The k-th return costs 34+7(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,530,500 plus 70,000 locked for 40,000. A rented-census ring fails: one key, one route. Honest agents pay 34 once and reclaim the bond.
